subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp add opt-in exact-server-timestamp coalescing, and what maximum arrival delay and configuration precedence should define that contract?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the gap, but code cannot safely choose the latency, collision, default, tolerance, and public configuration policy because each choice changes user-visible message timing and grouping.

options.title: Opt-in exact timestamp
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-local disabled-by-default setting that groups only exact timestamp matches with a bounded maximum hold and explicit bypass rules.

options.title: Use the broad coalescing RFC
options.body: Defer implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51361 defines a shared cross-channel batching contract that can express the WhatsApp case.

options.title: Keep receive-time debounce
options.body: Decline timestamp coalescing and document that users must increase debounceMs when Baileys delivers related messages several seconds apart.

recommendation.title: Opt-in exact timestamp
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-local disabled-by-default setting that groups only exact timestamp matches with a bounded maximum hold and explicit bypass rules.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the existing review and have the strongest available cross-surface history spanning WhatsApp, shared debounce, configuration, and documentation policy.
